parameters.name: ApplicationSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the application source. Valid values:

*   urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template: application template
*   urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard: standard protocol

parameters.name: ApplicationTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the application template. This parameter is required if you set the ApplicationSourceType parameter to urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:template.

parameters.name: LogoUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the application logo.

parameters.name: SsoType
parameters.description:
The SSO protocol. Valid values:

*   saml2: the SAML 2.0 protocol.
*   oidc: the OpenID Connect protocol.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-application --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --application-name Ram_Account_SSO --description RAM_account_SSO_application --logo-url https://oss.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/logo.png --application-source-type urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard --sso-type saml2 --application-template-id apt_ramuser_mjqrsi --application-identity-type application --custom-fields FieldValue=example-string FieldName=example-string --application-owner '{"GroupIds":["example-string"],"UserIds":["example-string"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationOwner.GroupIds.1 'example-string' --CustomFields.1.FieldName 'example-string' --ApplicationName Ram_Account_SSO --Description RAM_account_SSO_application --ApplicationTemplateId apt_ramuser_mjqrsi --ApplicationIdentityType application --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk2676xxxx --LogoUrl 'https://oss.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/logo.png' --ApplicationSourceType 'urn:alibaba:idaas:app:source:standard' --ApplicationOwner.UserIds.1 'example-string' --CustomFields.1.FieldValue 'example-string' --SsoType saml2 --method POST --force
